messages.message: ### Step 2: Direct Translation Translate each source line into Hindi, guided by the Reference Translation and Step 1 analysis. Output: ONE Hindi line per source line (preserve line count and end punctuation). Rules: - Follow the meaning from Reference Translation. - For "so X that Y": keep resultative structure, do NOT convert to "because". - No internal punctuation; copy only end punctuation from source.

### Step 3: Word Table & Coverage Check Build a word table from Step 2 translation, mapping each source word to its target equivalent. Output: ONE Markdown table (all lines combined). Columns: [Source Word] | [Contextual Definition] | [Target Word/Phrase] | [Back-Translation] | [Status: OK/MISSING/WRONG/GRAMMAR/UNNECESSARY] Mark GRAMMAR for agreement errors (gender, number, case) or other grammatical mistakes. Mark UNNECESSARY for elements present in source but not needed in target language (e.g., articles that target language omits naturally). After the table, list any MISSING, WRONG, GRAMMAR, or UNNECESSARY items.

**Word‑to‑Word Mapping Table**
| Source Word | Contextual Definition | Target Word / Phrase (Hindi) | Back‑Translation (Hindi → English) | Status | |-------------|----------------------|------------------------------|--------------------------------------|--------| | Vedi | imperative “see / behold” | देखो | “see / behold” | OK | | la | definite article (feminine) | — | — | UNNECESSARY | | bestia | “beast, monster” | दानव | “beast / monster” | OK | | per | preposition introducing cause | जिसके कारण | “because of which” | OK | | cu' (cui) | relative pronoun “which” | जिसके | “which” | OK | | io | first‑person singular pronoun “I” | मैं | “I” | OK | | mi (reflexive) | reflexive pronoun of *volsi* | — (reflexive is implicit in “मुड़ गया”) | — | UNNECESSARY | | volsi | “turned” (past) | मुड़ गया | “turned” | OK | | aiutami | “help me” (imperative) | मेरी मदद करो | “help me” | OK | | da | preposition “against” | विरुद्ध | “against” | OK | | lei | third‑person feminine pronoun “her” | उसके | “her / of her” | OK | | famoso | “famous” (adjective) | प्रसिद्ध | “famous” | OK | | saggio | “sage, wise man” | ऋषि | “sage” | OK | | ch'ella (che ella) | conjunction “that / because” introducing cause | क्योंकि वह | “because she” | OK | | mi (possessive) | first‑person singular possessive “my” (object of trembling) | मेरे | “my” | OK | | fa | causative verb “makes” | देती | “makes / gives” | OK | | tremar | infinitive “to tremble” | कंपा | “tremble” | OK | | le | definite article (feminine plural) | — | — | UNNECESSARY | | vene | “veins” | रक्त नलिकाओं | “veins” | OK | | e | coordinating conjunction “and” | और | “and” | OK | | i | definite article (masculine plural) | — | — | UNNECESSARY | | polsi | “pulses” | धड़कनों | “pulses” | OK |
---
### Items Requiring Attention - **UNNECESSARY**: `la`, `mi` (reflexive in line 88), `le`, `i` – Italian articles and the reflexive pronoun have no direct equivalents in Hindi and are naturally omitted. - **No MISSING, WRONG, or GRAMMAR** entries: all required meanings are present and the Hindi translation respects gender, number, and case conventions.

### Step 4: Correction & Final Output Fix any MISSING, WRONG, or GRAMMAR items from Step 3. Reorder within line if needed; do not add new content words. Verify that the output contains only Hindi script; no other language scripts should be mixed in. Output format (use nested bullet list, not table): - Line N: - Original: ... - Issue: ... (or "none") - Corrected: ... (or "no change") Output final Hindi text in ONE code block, line by line (no extra prose).

- Line 88: - Original: देखो वह दानव जिसके कारण मैं मुड़ गया; - Issue: none - Corrected: no change
- Line 89: - Original: उसके विरुद्ध मेरी मदद करो, प्रसिद्ध ऋषि, - Issue: none - Corrected: no change
- Line 90: - Original: क्योंकि वह मेरे रक्त नलिकाओं और धड़कनों को कंपा देती है". - Issue: none - Corrected: no change
``` देखो वह दानव जिसके कारण मैं मुड़ गया; उसके विरुद्ध मेरी मदद करो, प्रसिद्ध ऋषि, क्योंकि वह मेरे रक्त नलिकाओं और धड़कनों को कंपा देती है". ```
